shortDescription: Convert videos, audio, and images on your PC with separately installed FFmpeg and FFprobe. Batch files, trim clips, and keep your files on your device.
description:
Requires separately installed FFmpeg and FFprobe for video, audio, and most image conversions. Use the Tools page for WinGet installation or manual-install guidance.

Your files. Your computer. The format you need.

LocalMorph is a desktop file converter that processes your files locally, without uploading them to a conversion server. Turn a video into a shareable MP4, extract its audio, convert a batch of photos, or prepare clips for your next project.

START SIMPLE, GO DEEPER WHEN YOU NEED TO
Add files or folders, choose a quick preset or output format, and review the batch before converting. See which files are compatible with your settings. Preview images and video in an expandable inspector, with a settings panel that grows with your window.

VIDEO, AUDIO, AND IMAGES
Work with formats including MP4, MKV, MOV, WebM, MP3, AAC, FLAC, WAV, Opus, PNG, JPEG, and WebP. Choose quality, resolution, frame rate, and audio settings. Hardware video encoding is used when supported and verified on your PC. Format availability depends on the selected conversion engine and installed components.

TOOLS FOR REAL MEDIA WORK
Trim clips, grab a frame, extract audio, select audio tracks, or add subtitles. Use a two-pass target-size preset to prepare files for sharing. Join compatible video clips without re-encoding, or split a video into shorter clips. Accurate splitting re-encodes; fast stream-copy splitting follows source keyframes. Optional measured loudness normalization, audio silence trimming, and supported HDR-to-SDR tone mapping provide more control when you need it.

A QUEUE YOU CAN FOLLOW
Import up to 2,000 supported files at a time. Convert in parallel, follow progress, and cancel individual jobs or the batch. Review completed files in history and reopen their results. Existing source files are protected, and removing a history entry does not delete the converted file.

LOCAL BY DESIGN
Media conversion runs on your PC. FFmpeg and FFprobe are not included in the Microsoft Store package. Document conversion and some image formats require additional external tools or Windows codecs; the Tools page shows what is available and what is missing. Installing tools or codecs may require internet access and acceptance of their own licenses.
productFeatures: Convert video, audio, and images locally on your PC
Add files or folders, with up to 2,000 supported files per import
Quick presets for sharing, target file size, audio extraction, and more
Expandable media preview with per-file trim and track controls
Join compatible clips without re-encoding, or split a video by duration
Measured loudness normalization and leading/trailing audio silence trimming
Quality, resolution, frame-rate, audio, crop, and subtitle controls
Parallel conversions, cancellation, and history with access to completed results
Hardware video encoding when supported and verified on your PC
Tools page explains required media tools, optional engines, and codecs
whatsNewForExistingListing: FFmpeg and FFprobe are installed separately using WinGet or manual setup. A roomier conversion workspace includes an expandable media preview and a settings panel that grows with the window. Task-based preflight explains which files can run. New media tools include compatible-video joining, duration splitting, measured loudness normalization, audio silence trimming, and supported HDR-to-SDR conversion. File intake is cancellable, and history records multiple outputs and partial results.
minimumHardware: x64 or ARM64 processor; install the package matching your PC
Separately installed FFmpeg and FFprobe compatible with your PC
Available disk space for source files, conversion work, and completed outputs
recommendedHardware: A GPU with a supported hardware video encoder for compatible conversion settings
Additional free disk space and memory for large files or parallel conversions
